records.title: Costa launches BluGenix with five blueberry varieties suited to Yunnan
records.summary: Reports the launch of BluGenix on 29 May 2026 as the brand and platform for Costa's blueberry breeding programme, introduced with five varieties: Bounty, Breeze, Cascade, Delight and Eterna. Shelf life of 27 days at 4 degrees Celsius is claimed for all five and up to 50 days for Eterna. Costa chief executive Marc Werner and Leon Van Biljon, regional director of Costa Berry International, are quoted. The article describes the programme as drawing on close to 40 years of plant breeding expertise, and names South Africa, Zimbabwe, Morocco, the United States, Mexico, Peru, China and Australia as growing countries for BluGenix varieties.
records.analysis: A competitor putting a brand in front of its breeding programme is a shift from selling varieties to selling a platform, which is the same move Fall Creek made with Sekoya and United Exports with OZblu. The shelf-life claims carry no method, and the close to 40 years figure contradicts the more than 25 years Costa states on its own programme page.

facts.text: South Africa, Zimbabwe, Morocco, the United States, Mexico, Peru, China and Australia are named as growing countries for BluGenix varieties.
BluGenix was launched on 29 May 2026 as the brand and platform for Costa's blueberry breeding programme, introduced with five varieties: Bounty, Breeze, Cascade, Delight and Eterna.

Costa claims a shelf life of 27 days at 4 degrees Celsius for all five launch BluGenix varieties and up to 50 days for Eterna. No trial site, season, replication or measurement protocol is stated for either figure.

records.title: Naturipe Farms and Hortifrut expand berry genetics platform with Mountain Blue
records.summary: Joint Naturipe Farms and Hortifrut announcement dated 30 July 2026 of an expanded berry genetics platform reached through a strategic collaboration with Mountain Blue Orchards. Hortifrut states it gains access to new elite blueberry selections for the United States, Mexico, Peru and other Latin American countries. Hortifrut CEO Hector Lujan and Mountain Blue International Business Manager Mano Babiolakis are quoted. The release also mentions Hortifrut's 2025 global B Corp certification.
records.analysis: If it holds, this connects the largest listed blueberry producer to the Ridley breeding lineage, which until now reached the Americas through separate licensing arrangements. It is the single most consequential structural development in the package, and it rests on one originating announcement.

facts.text: On 30 July 2026 Naturipe Farms and Hortifrut announced an expanded berry genetics platform reached through a strategic collaboration with Mountain Blue Orchards, under which Hortifrut states it gains access to new elite blueberry selections for the United States, Mexico, Peru and other Latin American countries.

Mountain Blue Orchards, named in the 30 July 2026 Hortifrut and Naturipe genetics announcement, and Michigan Blueberry Growers Association, Hortifrut's Berry Blue joint venture partner, are separately named organisations in the retrieved sources and are not stated anywhere to be the same entity.
